replacement.title: Case 1 — Dynamic Device Replacement (AirQuality)
replacement.description: An unanticipated AirQualitySimplified device replaces the inactive baseline AirQuality sensor in the indoors zone. The embedding matcher must rank the airquality class first.

candidates.name: indoors_airqualitysimp
candidates.sdf_description: sensor device for air quality, measures temperature in degrees celsius, humidity percentage, particulate matter pm2.5 and pm10 concentrations in micrograms per cubic meter, carbon monoxide level, indoors environment monitoring

complementary.title: Case 2 — Complementary Robot Adoption (BodyConfig)
complementary.description: A second PickUpRobot is added to the body configuration station to accelerate chassis assembly. The embedding matcher must rank pickuprobot first.

candidates.name: bodyconfig_pickuprob2
candidates.sdf_description: industrial robotic arm for picking and placing vehicle chassis parts, joint positions x and y and z in meters, joint velocity, joint acceleration, end effector gripper state open or closed, actuator status, assembly line automation

disappearance.title: Case 3 — Device Disappearance & Replacement Suggestion
disappearance.description: Three devices stop publishing to MQTT. For each missing device, the matcher suggests the closest existing class and flags candidate replacement devices from the incoming buffer.

disappeared.name: windowmilling_pickuprob
disappeared.sdf_description: industrial robotic arm for picking and placing window frames during milling, joint positions and velocities, gripper state, window milling station automation

disappeared.name: indoors_airquality
disappeared.sdf_description: sensor device for air quality, temperature, humidity, particulate matter pm2.5, indoors environment monitoring

disappeared.name: outdoors_windsensor
disappeared.sdf_description: weather sensor measuring wind speed in meters per second and wind direction in degrees, outdoor environment monitoring
